description: Defines the ReportingContext class which manages internal components of the Reporting system, including policies, cache, uploader, delegate, and observers.

classes.name: ReportingContext
classes.description: Manages internal components and observers for the Reporting system, providing creation, accessors, and notification methods.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new ReportingContext instance with specified policy, request context, and store.

methods.name: policy
methods.description: Returns the current ReportingPolicy.

methods.name: clock
methods.description: Returns the clock used by the ReportingContext.

methods.name: tick_clock
methods.description: Returns the tick clock used by the ReportingContext.

methods.name: uploader
methods.description: Returns the ReportingUploader instance.

methods.name: delegate
methods.description: Returns the ReportingDelegate instance.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Returns the ReportingCache instance.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Returns the PersistentReportingStore.

methods.name: delivery_agent
methods.description: Returns the ReportingDeliveryAgent instance.

methods.name: garbage_collector
methods.description: Returns the ReportingGarbageCollector instance.

methods.name: AddCacheObserver
methods.description: Adds a ReportingCacheObserver to the observer list.

methods.name: RemoveCacheObserver
methods.description: Removes a ReportingCacheObserver from the observer list.

methods.name: NotifyCachedReportsUpdated
methods.description: Notifies observers that cached reports have been updated.

methods.name: NotifyReportAdded
methods.description: Notifies observers that a report has been added.

methods.name: NotifyReportUpdated
methods.description: Notifies observers that a report has been updated.

methods.name: NotifyCachedClientsUpdated
methods.description: Notifies observers that cached clients have been updated.

methods.name: NotifyEndpointsUpdatedForOrigin
methods.description: Notifies observers that endpoints for a specific origin have been updated.

methods.name: IsReportDataPersisted
methods.description: Returns whether report data is persisted across restarts.

methods.name: IsClientDataPersisted
methods.description: Returns whether client data is persisted across restarts.

methods.name: OnShutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup and shutdown procedures.
